baseline_coverage.rationale: The student's 24 baseline capabilities are broad, well-grounded and often more accurate than the reference (ProximitySensor condition, HasDialingMaximum quirk, event-result chain, antifraud detail), but three clusters of behaviours the reference covers correctly are missing: service-level behaviours of call_manager_service.cpp (InputDialerSpecialCode, SendCallUiEvent routing, SetCallPolicyInfo, voice-mail count reset, GetProxyObjectPtr), the OOBE-rejection and ESIM one-number-dual-terminal branches in the uplink state machine, and the CRS video-ring plus VideoStateUpdated voice/video device-switch chains in the audio module. Several medium gaps -> 3.

code_level_design.rationale: The design is unusually concrete (file-by-file deletion lists, per-macro placement table, stub naming, todo tag table, risks, rollback) and covers concurrency and the direct-call/stub architecture well. However: the proposal's claimed CRS (video ring) trim is never turned into code-level actions (no design decision, no delta Migration entry, unlike the reference); the student's own artifacts contradict each other (design deletes call_manager_proxy.cpp while the client-framework delta still specifies registration via CallManagerProxy::RegisterCallBack; the call-report delta silently collapses the state-registry dual route to a single slotId route with no proposal/design trace and no AGENTS.md basis); and knock-on effects are only half-handled (waiting-tone chain kept while its first step into the removed IMSCall video machine is silently dropped; design's removed-callType drop rule vs delta keeping UpdateOttEventInfo dispatch; FoldStatusManager listener cleanup not listed). Several medium gaps -> 3.

testability_grounding.rationale: Scenarios are generally concrete (error codes, functions, injected stub values, timings) and expand decision chains better than the reference in places, but the deltas systematically pad near-duplicate scenarios: the same WHEN/THEN restated under two titles (~11 pairs in call-state-observer delta alone; 374 scenarios total vs 143), which the rubric explicitly penalizes. In addition, safety-relevant ECC behaviour has scenarios but no gtest task (only a review item), while the reference has explicit ECC gtests. One high-severity plus one medium gap -> 3.

readability_rules.rationale: zh-CN prose with English OpenSpec keywords, 25-row trim table, per-capability deltas, decision index with 决策/理由/落点, real open questions, tables for enumerations, no long code blocks. Minor deductions only: the near-duplicate scenario pairs inflate and repeat content, a few delta requirement/scenario titles are kept while their THEN now asserts the opposite (e.g. 六类通话对象按类型构造 now describing two types; IMS 对象构造后初始化视频状态 whose THEN says InitVideoCall is not called), and some WHEN clauses embed rationale. 4.

gaps.summary: VOIP 类型通话（AGENTS.md：暂不支持，依赖后续畅连通话）：参考 stub（代码与逻辑保留，但外部接入或依赖调用换成桩 / todo 占位，功能暂不可用、待后续接入），学生 remove（该功能的代码不迁移：文件、对象、分支删除，liteOS 版本中不存在）。AGENTS.md 将 VOIP 单列为「暂不支持，依赖后续跟 meetime 畅连通话解决畅连与蜂窝通话冲突场景」，与不支持清单「相关代码无需迁移」刻意区分，且总约束明确「代码按功能实现，不能因为无外部接口而丢弃功能」。reference 保留 VoIPCall、voipCallObjectList_ 与 CarrierAndVoipConflictProcess/HangUpVoipCall/HandleVoipCallReportInfo 并仅桩化 VoipCallConnection，符合该口径；student 整通路删除（voip_call.cpp、voip_call_connection.cpp 及织入 CS/IMS 主流程的冲突分支），丢弃了 AGENTS.md 为畅连明确预留的冲突处理能力。
gaps.evidence: AGENTS.md 功能范围（VOIP 暂不支持、依赖畅连）与约束（不能因为无外部接口而丢弃功能）；telephony_call_manager/services/call/src/call_status_manager.cpp:126（TYPE_VOIP→HandleVoipCallReportInfo）、call_control_manager.cpp:330（CarrierAndVoipConflictProcess）、call_object_manager.cpp:80-83（AddOneCallObject 的 VoIP 振铃判定）

gaps.summary: 现有的锁（std::mutex、ffrt::mutex 等）与加锁调用（remove = 锁成员与加锁调用删除；keep = 加锁代码保留，原样或换成空实现的桩）：参考 remove（删除：对应代码不迁移），学生 keep（保留：对应代码保留（原样，或换成空实现的桩））。AGENTS.md 只说单线程环境「不需要加锁」，并未要求删除既有锁；student 原样保留 std::mutex（单线程无争用、行为一致，契合「架构尽量与 HMOS 保持一致」）并将 ffrt::mutex 换空实现桩（符合 ffrt 打桩规则）。reference 删除全部锁成员与加锁调用是同一前提下的另一种合理处置，两种做法运行时行为一致，属可辩护的架构取舍。
gaps.evidence: AGENTS.md「以下接口不调用：…目前只有一个线程，因此不需要加锁」、ffrt 替换/打桩条目与架构要求；student design.md D5（std::mutex 原样保留、ffrt::mutex 空桩）；reference design.md D7
